title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Auckland with our guide, featuring prices and contract terms from top franchises like Anytime Fitness and Jetts
intro: Auckland's fitness scene is thriving, with a wide range of gyms to suit every budget and lifestyle. With prices starting from just $15 per week, there's never been a better time to get fit in Auckland. From commuter-friendly gyms in the CBD to 24/7 options in the suburbs, we've got you covered

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms in Auckland CBD
sections.body: For those who work in the city, a convenient gym location is key. Anytime Fitness has several locations in the Auckland CBD, with prices starting from $24.95 per week on a 12-month contract. Jetts also has a presence in the CBD, with a 12-month contract priced at $19.95 per week

sections.heading: 24/7 Gyms in Auckland
list: Anytime Fitness - with locations in Albany, Henderson, and Manukau
Jetts - with locations in Auckland CBD, Newmarket, and Pakuranga
Snap Fitness - with locations in Auckland CBD, Ellerslie, and Takapuna

sections.heading: Gyms with Free Parking in Auckland
sections.body: For those who prefer to drive to the gym, free parking is a must. CityFitness has several locations with free parking, including their gyms in Newmarket and Hamilton. Les Mills also offers free parking at their gym in Takapuna

sections.heading: Cheap Gyms in Auckland
sections.body: If budget is a concern, there are several affordable gym options in Auckland. Jetts is one of the cheapest options, with a 12-month contract priced at just $19.95 per week. Anytime Fitness also offers a competitive price, with a 12-month contract starting from $24.95 per week
